evidence.note: Prose tracks progress at a coarse subsystem level ('health, registration, workspace creation, message posting work'; then lists static-review risks) — concrete but not tied to any enumerated contract checklist.

Notes cross-node WebSocket and IRC bridging 'passed' and lists a handful of remaining edge gaps (idempotent delete, group reads, invitation expiry, UI hooks). Shows some awareness of what's left but only for a narrow slice of the surface.

At step 7 it explicitly says gaps remain 'before declaring done,' then at steps 8-9 kills the supervisor and marks complete without confirming those gaps were closed — the status notes were not used to gate completion.

Entire resilience surface (SIGKILL node, broadcast-kill), search, slash commands, mentions, read-state, groups, pins, and reactions are never verified or tracked — whole feature families silently absent from the progress picture.

reasoning: The agent maintains only concrete-but-narrow per-step notes on what it just smoke-tested (auth/CRUD, cross-node WS, IRC), with no explicit done/partial/failing ledger and no cross-check against the spec's large contract list. It silently drops whole subsystems (resilience, search, groups, read-state, mentions) and marks the task complete despite its own step-7 note that edge gaps remained 'before declaring done,' so it does not catch most omissions before finishing. That matches anchor 3 (vague/incomplete coverage picture, major areas never built) rather than the subsystem-complete awareness of anchor 5.
